hero.title: Games anyone can join. Donations that go straight to families.
hero.description: Every Karma event is a free pickup game or community run — no tryouts, no experience, no equipment required. Show up, play, and bring what you can for the families we're supporting that week.

empty.title: No events match those filters
empty.body: Try a different sport, or check past events to see what we've been up to. New games get added often.

detail.helpsIntro: Donations from this event go to
detail.registerBody: We're building online registration and QR check-in for a future release. For now, just show up — spots are first-come, first-served on the field.

notFound.title: We couldn't find that event
notFound.body: It may have been rescheduled, or the link is off. Take a look at everything coming up.
